Why are thousands of students protesting in Jharkhand? And why has this issue received so little national attention?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu uncover the long history of alleged paper leaks, recruitment irregularities, and corruption in Jharkhand's examination system. From the controversy surrounding the 14th JPSC exam to students' demands for a CBI probe, institutional reforms, and greater accountability, we explain why these protests are about much more than just one examination.
